newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta weakens, as mark boosted by EMU delay talk.
newsitem.headline: Peseta weakens, as mark boosted by EMU delay talk.

text.p: The peseta weakened a bit on Monday morning punished by a recovering mark amid fresh fears of delay in European monetary union and a broadly weaker dollar.
But dealers added the peseta's fall should be limited by fears of Bank of Spain intervention.
Chart analysts said the peseta was expected to remain in a tight trading range between 84.55/60 per mark and strong resistance at 84.95/85.00, seen supported by the Bank of Spain in that region.
At around 0915 GMT the peseta was trading at around 84.80/83 per mark compared with levels seen late on Friday at around 84.67/69.
The peseta was trading at 144.89/01 against the dollar compared with 145.57/60 late on Friday.
